newsitem.title: USA: Assets of U.S. money market funds rose in week.
newsitem.headline: Assets of U.S. money market funds rose in week.

text.p: Total money market mutual fund assets in the week ended July 2 rose to $978.95 billion from a revised $968.18 billion the prior week, an industry trade group said Thursday.

The Investment Company Institute said assets of the nation's 669 retail money market mutual funds rose $5.78 billion to $647.76 billion in the week. Of the retail funds, assets of the 404 taxable money market funds rose $2.75 billion to $531.16 billion, while assets of the 265 tax-exempt funds increased $3.03 billion to $116.60 billion, the group said.

ICI said assets of the 327 institutional money market funds rose $5.00 billion to $331.19 billion. Of these, assets of the 264 taxable money market funds increased $2.62 billion to $295.17 billion, while assets of the 63 tax-exempt funds were up by $2.38 billion to $36.02 billion, it said.
Total assets for the week to June 25 were revised to $968.18 billion from $967.84 billion, because of reporting errors and a change in the number of funds reporting, the group said.
